sources.title: Meta and Microsoft Introduce the Next Generation of Llama
sources.evidence: Dated July 18, 2023; announces immediate availability of Llama 2 pretrained and conversational model weights and starting code.

sources.title: Llama-2-70b-hf official model card
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies this repository as the 70B pretrained model converted to Transformers. Lists Meta as developer, text input/output, nominal 70B, 4k context and GQA; distinguishes Chat variants. Weights require license acceptance.

sources.title: Original Llama 2 model card, llama_v2 branch
sources.evidence: Documents the Llama 2 family, pretrained and tuned variants, text-only modalities, custom license, and the 70B row with 4k context and GQA. Does not separately define active parameter counts.

sources.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
sources.evidence: Section 2.2 describes standard Transformer, RMSNorm, SwiGLU and RoPE. Appendix A.2.1 specifies 4096-token context and GQA for 70B. Section 5.1 tool-emergence examples concern Llama 2-Chat, not the base checkpoint.

sources.title: Llama 2 reference Transformer implementation
sources.evidence: TransformerBlock uses attention plus a single three-projection SwiGLU feed-forward network; every block runs in the forward path, without an expert router. Token embeddings and output projection are separate modules; RoPE and KV caches are computed tensors. No checkpoint count was derived.

sources.title: Llama 2 Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: Names the custom Llama 2 Community License and explicitly states the version release date July 18, 2023; grants conditional use and redistribution rights for model materials including weights.

sources.title: Llama 2 original release and inference README
sources.evidence: Documents released weights, license-gated downloads, 70B inference, maximum 4096-token sequences, and that pretrained models are text-completion models not fine-tuned for chat or Q&A.

sources.title: Exact Llama-2-70b-hf configuration (access restricted)
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated direct request returned HTTP 401 requiring approved access. No gated content or weight tensors were downloaded; exact config and checkpoint count are not claimed.

name.note: Exact 70B pretrained variant; excludes Chat, Llama 1 65B and later Llama generations.

developer.note: Official model cards identify Meta as the developer.

family.note: Normalized family identifier for the explicitly named Llama 2 family.

release_date.note: Public release date is explicit in both the announcement and version license; not inferred from repository creation.

open_weights.note: Meta released pretrained weights under license and access conditions; open weights does not mean an unrestricted license.

license.note: Custom license with conditional redistribution and commercial terms; not an Apache/MIT classification.

parameters_b.note: Explicit nominal total in billions for the exact pretrained 70B model. Not a precise tensor count; gated config access is unnecessary to verify the published nominal size.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active count is supplied. Dense block execution does not establish a unique per-token learned-parameter count, especially for embedding lookup; do not copy total into active.

architecture.note: Dense autoregressive Transformer is supported by the standard attention/SwiGLU implementation without routed experts; the paper specifically assigns GQA to 70B.

context_window.note: Original supported sequence length is explicitly 4096 tokens. Later extensions and code cache allocation defaults do not change the released context specification.

modalities.note: Original model card explicitly specifies text-only input and output.

reasoning.note: No dedicated reasoning mode is documented for this pretrained checkpoint. General reasoning benchmarks or prompted text completions do not establish such a feature.

tool_call.note: No native tool-call interface is documented for this base checkpoint. The paper discusses prompted tool emergence in Chat, so that finding is not transferred here.

description.note: The existing concise description correctly identifies the base pretrained release.

patch.notes: 70B is Meta's nominal total, not an independently counted checkpoint total. Active parameters and dedicated reasoning/native tool-call support are not separately documented. This is the original pretrained base model with GQA and a 4,096-token context, distributed under the custom Llama 2 Community License. The exact Hugging Face config required authorized access (HTTP 401).

summary: Confirmed all existing factual values for the exact Llama 2 70B base checkpoint. Added primary provenance and explicit nominal-count/access caveats. Total remains nominal 70B; active count, dedicated reasoning and native tools remain null. Exact gated config was unavailable, with no access bypass or weight download.
